people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Calneh
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, possibly Kullania or Kullanhu

people.name: Eden
people.line: A city or region, possibly in Mesopotamia or Syria.

people.name: Haran
people.line: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.

people.name: Sheba
people.line: Kingdom known for wealth, trade, and the Queen of Sheba

translations.web: “ ‘ “Haran, Canneh, and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.
translations.bsb: Haran, Canneh, and Eden traded with you, and so did the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad.
translations.kjv: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
translations.asv: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traffickers of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were thy traffickers.
